panels.title: Consul leader
panels.description: Which Consul server is Raft leader over time (only the leader signs leaf CSRs).

panels.title: Vault active node
panels.description: Which Vault node is active over time. Standbys still serve no_store signing locally.

panels.title: Leader elections (per 5m)
panels.description: Consul: Raft state counters (candidacies > leaders elected means failed/split votes). Vault: active-node flips (/2 because one node goes 1->0 and another 0->1). Any non-zero value during a test is worth investigating.

panels.title: Autopilot failure tolerance
panels.description: How many voters can fail without losing quorum (5 voters = 2).

panels.title: Autopilot healthy
panels.description: 1 = all servers healthy per Autopilot.

panels.title: Vault leader contact (followers)
panels.description: Time since followers last heard from the leader. Rising values precede elections.

panels.title: Consul Raft commit time
panels.description: Time for the leader to commit a log entry (quorum append). Leader-only; every leaf signing is one Raft write.

panels.title: Consul Raft leader last contact
panels.description: Time since the leader last heard from followers. Rising values precede elections.

panels.title: Consul Raft applies / s
panels.description: Raft log applies on the leader (raft.apply), with the leaf-signing and KV share from FSM counters.

panels.title: Consul Connect CA (leaf signing via Vault)
Leaf certificates signed / s
panels.description: Each ConnectCA.Sign bumps the CA leaf index via Raft. Only the Consul leader signs; all servers apply the entry, hence max().

panels.title: Consul RPC requests / errors per server
Consul FSM apply time (leaf index)
panels.description: Time to apply each leaf-signing Raft entry to the state store.

panels.title: Consul → Vault TCP connections
panels.description: Established connections from each Consul server to Vault :8200 (ss, every 5s). The leader's Vault CA provider is expected to use one pooled HTTP/2 connection.

panels.title: Leaf signing concentration (busiest Vault node)
panels.description: Share of sign requests on Consul's intermediate served by the busiest Vault node. ~100% = pinned to one node (one connection).

panels.title: Consul server CPU
panels.description: The leader signs every CSR; with Consul Dataplane, servers also generate proxy keys.

panels.title: Vault requests handled per node
panels.description: With no_store=true, performance standbys (incl. non-voters) sign locally. Direct clients spread across nodes; the Consul leader's pooled connection usually pins its signing to one node.

panels.title: Vault sign latency (Consul intermediate)
panels.description: Vault-side time for <connect_dc_inter>/sign/leaf-cert - the call the Consul leader makes per leaf.

panels.title: Vault Raft commit time
panels.description: no_store signing does not write to Raft; this moves with other writes.

panels.title: Client requests / failures per second
panels.description: What the load generators sent, summed across nodes. 'name' is the k6 request tag (leaf, sign, register, leaf_wait).

panels.title: Client latency (worst load generator)
panels.description: Caller-observed latency from k6 (remote write trend stats), worst node per request name.

panels.title: Burst: registration to leaf ready
panels.description: consul-register-burst.js only: time from sidecar registration until its leaf is available.

panels.title: Disk space used
panels.description: Fullest filesystem per host (root, Raft data, audit log).

panels.title: Security scanner active
panels.description: perf_scanner_active: a security/inventory scanner (e.g. a vulnerability scanner on the image) is running. Scans cost CPU; run-plan.sh waits for them before testing and flags tests they overlapped.

panels.title: CPU steal
panels.description: Time the hypervisor gave to other tenants. Non-zero on burstable (t3/t4g) instances when out of credits.

panels.title: CPU I/O wait
panels.description: CPU idle while waiting for disk (Raft data volumes, audit log).
